top_violation_types.title: Signed Admission Form (26 TAC §746.607)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's admission forms did not have the parent's signature.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §746.501(a)(23))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have instructions on how parents may access minimum standards online in their operational policy.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were lacking information related to the support of inclusive services.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not provided parents with a copy of the parent's rights form 2987 as required.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is missing how they would evacuate children younger then 24 months out of the operation doing an emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.
